title: PRD interlock noticeboard and staggered acceptance windows for cross-team signoffs
creator: Aisha Mohammed
description:
Goal: Create a lightweight, predictable PRD signoff mechanism (the 'Interlock Noticeboard') that structures staggered acceptance windows for engineering, design, and legal so we can ship the Private Edition PRD without late blockers.

Background: Recent PRD handoffs have produced last-minute scope cuts when legal or infra discover blockers after engineering has landed work. That causes rework, missed SLAs for Dedicated commitments, and friction with enterprise customers. The Noticeboard will: (1) make explicit what each team must review, when, and which artifacts are authoritative; (2) define acceptance criteria per team with pass/fail signals; (3) provide remediation lanes and a clear rollback/freeze policy if a blocking issue is discovered in the final acceptance window.

What success looks like:
- Each dependent team acknowledges their checklist in the Noticeboard at least 5 business days before release.
- No new scope-blocking legal comments opened in the final 48-hour window.
- Engineering completes QA and SRE readiness checks within their window; if not, rollback gate triggers automatic model/route pin fallback.

Acceptance criteria (explicit, non-normative list used by reviewers):
1) Engineering: documented rollout plan, canary/rollback steps, K8s/infra runbook linked, SLO and latency regression test results attached.
2) Design: updated Console flows, annotated mocks for the rollout state, accessibility checks passed, guidance for UX-telemetry flags.
3) Legal/Security: data residency and encryption wording approved; audit log retention & KMS integration signoff documented.
4) PM: final QA checklist completed and all dependent items marked green, or a mitigation plan with owners & timeline submitted.

Noticeboard mechanics:
- A central Confluence page is the canonical artifact with embedded checklist. Link included in comments.
- Staggered windows: Design review window opens first (T-12 days), Engineering window opens (T-9), Legal review (T-7), final cross-team sync (T-3). Each window has an explicit owner and a single-line decision outcome: Approve / Approve with non-blocking comments / Block.
- If Legal or Eng report a 'Block' inside the final 48 hours, the configured rollback trigger is activated and PM will pull the runtime route pin to the previous model variant.

Out of scope: creating a custom tooling UI for the Noticeboard (we will use Confluence + Slack automation for this ticket).

Authoritative links: Confluence PRD: https://company.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PROD/pages/PE-PRD-2026, Draft rollout runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/pe-rollout, Draft console mocks: https://figma.com/file/xyz
